postconditions.description: The number of groups is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
Each group has between 1 and 100 friends, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: Each friend's profile can be accessed by the profile of every other friend by following some sequence of profile visits.
postconditions.description: The friend lists are structured such that each profile can be reached from any other profile by a sequence of visits.

postconditions.expression: Each person in a group have at least one friend and he/she cannot be in his/her own friend list.
postconditions.description: Each friend list includes at least one friend and does not include the person themselves.

The function `find_most_popular_friend` takes the number of groups and a list of lists of friends in each group, and returns the most popular friend's label along with the average distance from all other friends in the group.
